Windows Setup package (this download: SlateSetup.exe + docs)

This Windows installer package is community porting / install tooling
(GitHub: ChrisToast89). It is NOT published by Sam Wasserman and must not
be represented as an official Wasserman Productions release.

The package maintainer acts only as:
  • fork curator (ChrisToast89)
  • Windows install / port tooling contributor

— not as the creator of Slate.

Windows-ready app source used by Setup:
  https://github.com/ChrisToast89/slate  (branch: windows-support)
  (fork of https://github.com/wassermanproductions/slate)

What this package does:
  • Guided GUI setup for Windows
  • Downloads Slate from the official GitHub repository when run online
  • Applies community Windows compatibility steps during install
  • Installs the app per-user; protects Documents\Slate project data

For the original project, support, and attribution of the app itself, see:
  https://github.com/wassermanproductions/slate
  https://wassermanproductions.com
